function GSTATS.merge_defaults() if GSTATS.state.font ~= nil and GSTATS.state.fontsize == nil then GSTATS.state.fontsize = GSTATS.state.font end GSTATS.state.font = nil for k, v in pairs(GSTATS.defaults) do if GSTATS.state[k] == nil then GSTATS.state[k] = v end end local score_modes = { none = true, tactical = true, vitals = true, sheet = true, minimal = true } local score_mode = tostring(GSTATS.state.score_mode or "none"):lower() GSTATS.state.score_mode = score_modes[score_mode] and score_mode or "none"
if type(GSTATS.state.statusbar) ~= "table" then GSTATS.state.statusbar = {} end if GSTATS.state.statusbar.show_double_xp == nil and GSTATS.state.statusbar.show_tnl ~= nil then GSTATS.state.statusbar.show_double_xp = GSTATS.state.statusbar.show_tnl == true end GSTATS.state.statusbar.show_tnl = nil for k, v in pairs(GSTATS.statusbar_defaults) do if GSTATS.state.statusbar[k] == nil then GSTATS.state.statusbar[k] = v end end
local statusbar = GSTATS.state.statusbar local layouts = { rail=true, stack=true, pips=true, basic=true } local layout = tostring(statusbar.layout or "rail"):lower() if layout == "duel" or layout == "deck" or layout == "linestack" or layout == "adaptive" then layout = "rail" end statusbar.layout = layouts[layout] and layout or "rail" local skins = { clean=true, capsule=true } local skin = tostring(statusbar.skin or "clean"):lower() statusbar.skin = skins[skin] and skin or "clean" statusbar.vertical_bars = statusbar.vertical_bars == true if statusbar.horizontal_width == nil then statusbar.horizontal_width = statusbar.vertical_bars and 700 or statusbar.width end if statusbar.horizontal_height == nil then statusbar.horizontal_height = statusbar.vertical_bars and 82 or statusbar.height end if statusbar.vertical_width == nil then statusbar.vertical_width = statusbar.vertical_bars and statusbar.width or 220 end if statusbar.vertical_height == nil then statusbar.vertical_height = statusbar.vertical_bars and statusbar.height or 360 end statusbar.resource_focus = nil local statusbar_fontsize = tonumber(statusbar.fontsize) or 9 statusbar.fontsize = math.max(8, math.min(16, math.floor(statusbar_fontsize + 0.5))) local pulse_mode = statusbar.pulse_mode if tonumber(pulse_mode) and tonumber(pulse_mode) >= 2 and tonumber(pulse_mode) <= 5 and tonumber(pulse_mode) == math.floor(tonumber(pulse_mode)) then statusbar.pulse_mode = tonumber(pulse_mode) elseif tostring(pulse_mode or "off"):lower() == "auto" then statusbar.pulse_mode = "auto" else statusbar.pulse_mode = "off" end local double_xp_ends_at = tonumber(statusbar.double_xp_ends_at) statusbar.double_xp_ends_at = double_xp_ends_at and double_xp_ends_at > os.time() and double_xp_ends_at or nil end
function GSTATS.load_state() if type(table.load) == "function" then local loaded_into = {} local ok, loaded_a, loaded_b = pcall(table.load, GSTATS.state_file, loaded_into) if ok then if next(loaded_into) ~= nil then GSTATS.state = loaded_into elseif type(loaded_a) == "table" then GSTATS.state = loaded_a elseif loaded_a == true and type(loaded_b) == "table" then GSTATS.state = loaded_b end end elseif yajl and yajl.to_value then local f = io.open(GSTATS.state_file, "r") if f then local raw = f:read("*a") f:close() local ok, loaded = pcall(yajl.to_value, raw) if ok and type(loaded) == "table" then GSTATS.state = loaded end end end GSTATS.merge_defaults() end
function GSTATS.save_state() if GSTATS.save_timer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, GSTATS.save_timer) end GSTATS.save_timer = nil
if GSTATS.ui and GSTATS.ui.container then if GSTATS.ui.container.get_x then GSTATS.state.x = GSTATS.ui.container:get_x() end if GSTATS.ui.container.get_y then GSTATS.state.y = GSTATS.ui.container:get_y() end if GSTATS.ui.container.get_width then GSTATS.state.width = GSTATS.ui.container:get_width() end if GSTATS.ui.container.get_height then GSTATS.state.height = GSTATS.ui.container:get_height() end end local statusbar = GSTATS.state and GSTATS.state.statusbar local statusbar_container = GSTATS.ui and GSTATS.ui.statusbar_container if statusbar and statusbar_container then if statusbar_container.get_x then statusbar.x = statusbar_container:get_x() end if statusbar_container.get_y then statusbar.y = statusbar_container:get_y() end if statusbar_container.get_width then statusbar.width = statusbar_container:get_width() end if statusbar_container.get_height then statusbar.height = statusbar_container:get_height() end if statusbar.vertical_bars and statusbar.layout ~= "basic" then statusbar.vertical_width = statusbar.width statusbar.vertical_height = statusbar.height else statusbar.horizontal_width = statusbar.width statusbar.horizontal_height = statusbar.height end end local config_container = GSTATS.ui and GSTATS.ui.statusbar_config if statusbar and config_container then if config_container.get_x then statusbar.config_x = config_container:get_x() end if config_container.get_y then statusbar.config_y = config_container:get_y() end end if type(table.save) == "function" then local ok = pcall(table.save, GSTATS.state_file, GSTATS.state) if ok then GSTATS.state_dirty = false return true end end
if yajl and yajl.to_string then local ok, payload = pcall(yajl.to_string, GSTATS.state) if ok and payload then local f = io.open(GSTATS.state_file, "w") if f then f:write(payload) f:close() GSTATS.state_dirty = false return true end end end return false end
function GSTATS.schedule_state_save(delay) GSTATS.state_dirty = true if GSTATS.save_timer then return end
if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then GSTATS.save_state() return end
local timer_id = tempTimer(delay or GSTATS.save_delay, function() GSTATS.save_timer = nil if GSTATS.state_dirty then GSTATS.save_state() end end) GSTATS.save_timer = timer_id if not timer_id then GSTATS.save_state() end end

function GSTATS.safe_number(...) for i = 1, select("#", ...) do local v = select(i, ...) if v ~= nil then local n = tonumber(v) if n then return n end end end return 0 end
function GSTATS.format_compact_number(value) local n = GSTATS.safe_number(value) local sign = "" if n < 0 then sign = "-" n = math.abs(n) end
if n < 1000 then return string.format("%s%d", sign, n) end
local scales = { { value = 1000000000000, suffix = "t" }, { value = 1000000000, suffix = "b" }, { value = 1000000, suffix = "m" }, { value = 1000, suffix = "k" }, }
for _, scale in ipairs(scales) do if n >= scale.value then local scaled = n / scale.value local rounded = math.floor(scaled * 10 + 0.5) / 10 local text = string.format("%.1f", rounded):gsub("%.0$", "") return string.format("%s%s%s", sign, text, scale.suffix) end end
return string.format("%s%d", sign, n) end

function GSTATS.statusbar_font_size() local value = tonumber(GSTATS.state and GSTATS.state.statusbar and GSTATS.state.statusbar.fontsize) or 9 return math.max(8, math.min(16, math.floor(value + 0.5))) end
function GSTATS.statusbar_info_row_count() local options = GSTATS.state and GSTATS.state.statusbar or {} if options.layout == "basic" then return 0 end return (options.show_double_xp and 1 or 0) + (options.show_combat and 1 or 0) + (options.show_needs and 1 or 0) end
function GSTATS.statusbar_minimum_width_for_font() local options = GSTATS.state and GSTATS.state.statusbar or {} if options.layout == "basic" then return 250 end if options.vertical_bars then return 104 end if options.layout == "pips" then return 280 end return 220 end
function GSTATS.statusbar_minimum_height_for_font() local font_size = GSTATS.statusbar_font_size() local options = GSTATS.state.statusbar if options.layout == "basic" then return math.max(28, font_size + 18) end local row_height = font_size + 8 local resource_count = (options.show_mana and 1 or 0) + (options.show_moves and 1 or 0) local core_height if options.layout == "rail" then local row_count = 1 + resource_count core_height = row_count * row_height + math.max(0, row_count - 1) * 4 elseif options.layout == "stack" and resource_count > 0 then core_height = row_height * 2 + 4 else core_height = row_height end local info_rows = GSTATS.statusbar_info_row_count() local info_row_height = math.max(20, font_size + 8) local footer_height = info_rows > 0 and info_rows * info_row_height + math.max(0, info_rows - 1) * 3 or 0 local footer_gap = info_rows > 0 and 4 or 0 if options.vertical_bars then return math.max(300, 7 + 220 + 4 + footer_height + footer_gap) end return math.max(82, 7 + core_height + 4 + footer_height + footer_gap) end
function GSTATS.statusbar_ensure_minimum_size() local container = GSTATS.ui and GSTATS.ui.statusbar_container if not container or type(container.resize) ~= "function" then return end local current_width, current_height = GSTATS.statusbar_size() local wanted_width = math.max(current_width, GSTATS.statusbar_minimum_width_for_font()) local wanted_height = math.max(current_height, GSTATS.statusbar_minimum_height_for_font()) if wanted_width ~= current_width or wanted_height ~= current_height then container:resize(wanted_width, wanted_height) GSTATS.state.statusbar.width = wanted_width GSTATS.state.statusbar.height = wanted_height end end
function GSTATS.statusbar_config_dimensions() local font_size = GSTATS.statusbar_font_size() local header_height = math.max(32, font_size + 23) local row_height = math.max(26, font_size + 15) local row_step = row_height + 2 local row_start = header_height + 4 local footer_font = math.max(8, font_size - 1) local footer_height = math.max(30, footer_font + 17) local footer_y = row_start + #GSTATS.statusbar_config_actions * row_step + 6 return { width = 440 + math.max(0, font_size - 9) * 12, height = footer_y + footer_height + 9, header_height = header_height, row_height = row_height, row_step = row_step, row_start = row_start, footer_font = footer_font, footer_height = footer_height, footer_y = footer_y, } end
function GSTATS.statusbar_apply_label_font(label, alignment) if not label then return end if type(label.processFormatString) == "function" then label:processFormatString(tostring(alignment or "") .. tostring(GSTATS.statusbar_font_size())) elseif type(label.setFontSize) == "function" then pcall(label.setFontSize, label, GSTATS.statusbar_font_size()) end end
function GSTATS.statusbar_escape(text) return tostring(text or ""):gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">") end
function GSTATS.statusbar_move_resize(object, x, y, width, height) if not object then return end if type(object.move) == "function" then pcall(object.move, object, x, y) end if type(object.resize) == "function" then pcall(object.resize, object, math.max(1, width), math.max(1, height)) end end
function GSTATS.statusbar_size() local c = GSTATS.ui and GSTATS.ui.statusbar_container local width = tonumber(GSTATS.state.statusbar.width) or 700 local height = tonumber(GSTATS.state.statusbar.height) or 82 if c and type(c.get_width) == "function" then local ok, value = pcall(c.get_width, c) if ok and tonumber(value) then width = tonumber(value) end end if c and type(c.get_height) == "function" then local ok, value = pcall(c.get_height, c) if ok and tonumber(value) then height = tonumber(value) end end return math.max(GSTATS.statusbar_minimum_width_for_font(), width), math.max(GSTATS.statusbar_minimum_height_for_font(), height) end
function GSTATS.statusbar_epoch_seconds() if type(getEpoch) == "function" then local ok, value = pcall(getEpoch) if ok and tonumber(value) then return tonumber(value) end end return os.clock() end
function GSTATS.statusbar_pulse_period() if not (GSTATS.last and GSTATS.last.in_combat) then return nil end local mode = GSTATS.state.statusbar.pulse_mode local override = tonumber(mode) if override and override >= 2 and override <= 5 then return override end if tostring(mode or "off"):lower() ~= "auto" then return nil end local subclass = tostring((GSTATS.last and GSTATS.last.subclass) or ""):lower() return subclass == "navigator" and 2 or 3 end
function GSTATS.update_statusbar_pulse() local gauge = GSTATS.ui and GSTATS.ui.statusbar_pulse if not gauge then return end local period = GSTATS.statusbar_active_pulse_period if not period or not GSTATS.state.statusbar.visible then gauge:hide() gauge:setValue(0, 100, "") return end gauge:show() local now = GSTATS.statusbar_epoch_seconds() local origin = GSTATS.statusbar_pulse_origin or now local elapsed = now - origin if elapsed < 0 then GSTATS.statusbar_pulse_origin = now elapsed = 0 end local remaining = 1 - ((elapsed % period) / period) gauge:setValue(math.max(0, math.min(100, remaining * 100)), 100, "") end
function GSTATS.sync_statusbar_pulse(reset) local period = GSTATS.statusbar_pulse_period() if not GSTATS.state.statusbar.visible then period = nil end if not reset and period == GSTATS.statusbar_active_pulse_period and (not period or GSTATS.statusbar_pulse_timer) then GSTATS.update_statusbar_pulse() return end
if GSTATS.statusbar_pulse_timer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, GSTATS.statusbar_pulse_timer) end GSTATS.statusbar_pulse_timer = nil GSTATS.statusbar_active_pulse_period = period GSTATS.statusbar_pulse_origin = GSTATS.statusbar_epoch_seconds() GSTATS.update_statusbar_pulse()
if period and type(tempTimer) == "function" then GSTATS.statusbar_pulse_timer = tempTimer(0.05, function() GSTATS.update_statusbar_pulse() end, true) end end
function GSTATS.statusbar_double_xp_status() local options = GSTATS.state and GSTATS.state.statusbar or {} local ends_at = tonumber(options.double_xp_ends_at) local remaining = ends_at and math.max(0, ends_at - os.time()) or 0 if remaining <= 0 then return "DXP OFF", "#8d9aab" end return "DXP " .. tostring(math.ceil(remaining / 60)) .. "min", "#f2c94c" end
